description: This file is a shell script that sets up and executes a comprehensive suite of automated tests for Git's rebase interactive functionality. It includes test preparations, various test scenarios (like reordering commits, editing commit messages, handling conflicts, using different options, and testing edge cases), and validation assertions. The tests are designed to verify that Git's interactive rebase features work correctly under multiple conditions and configurations.
